verdict.rationale: Pika documents a Talking Head Video app for making a virtual spokesperson, where you "add a script and choose a presenter, or use your own image and audio" for explainers and demos. This covers both the script-to-stock-presenter path and a custom-avatar path, and image-plus-audio lip sync is also documented. Missing for 10: detail on the stock presenter library and output length/quality; clarity on whether a custom-image avatar can be driven directly by a pasted script rather than user-supplied audio; any independent or hands-on corroboration beyond one-line vendor descriptions.
